scope: Historical local verification of N-5/N-6 on ccfc434; superseded by the current review report.

environment.dependencies: Project requirements and development dependencies; portable SQLite CLI 3.45.1

fixes.N-5: Enumerate aligned times, validate each prediction pair separately. A corrupt SQLite value affects its own pair and the following pair; subsequent healthy pairs and a healthy latest UI prediction succeed. Shared training feature validation is unchanged.

remaining_limits: Local integration and E2E could not execute past setup.
Only Python 3.12 available locally; 3.11/3.13 require current CI.
No live NIM/Telegram, production DB, Docker deployment or new Swagger/latency run.
